items.raw_excerpt: Police have admitted using AI to sharpen a photo of a stolen guitar, after the image sparked confusion over the instrument's true value.

items.raw_excerpt: New research shows that 24% of 15-year-olds have parents who are no longer together, just a slight increase from a decade ago, according to statistics bureau CBS. In 2025, 3.3 million children were living in the Netherlands. Around 782,000 had parents who are separated. Twenty years ago, around 13% of 15-year-olds had divorced parents. That number increased steadily, reaching 23% in 2016, when it plateaued. Most children of separated parents lived with their mother, particularly the youngest: 93
